headline: Oil Rises Following Reported U.S. Strike on Iran's Qeshm Island
summary: Oil prices increased following a reported U.S. strike on Iran's Qeshm Island.
why: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East frequently disrupt crude oil supplies and shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz, causing immediate volatility in global energy markets.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Supply risks in the Middle East directly lift crude oil prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical conflict in oil-producing regions threatens global supply chains, leading to immediate upward pressure on crude prices.
